title: Software licence seats exceeded
description: Marlow licensed 50 seats of our route-planning software. Our audit in February 2026 found 112 active users. The licence says extra seats are charged at the list price of £30 per seat per month from when they were first used. Marlow refused to pay the true-up invoice due 28 February 2026.
notes: Licensor is the claimant. Tests extraction of the audit numbers and the true-up term.
